verdict.rationale: New Relic exposes NerdGraph, a documented GraphQL API for querying metrics, logs, and traces via NRQL, plus an official MCP server explicitly built to let AI dev tools/agents query telemetry data in plain language (converted to NRQL) for production troubleshooting. This directly satisfies an external agent debugging production via documented APIs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of the MCP server or NerdGraph API in agentic workflows, and no public OpenAPI spec (only GraphQL).
